subject: Syntax question when doing multigroup analysis with 3 groups

messages.author: a039605c983c4992
messages.subject: Syntax question when doing multigroup analysis with 3 groups
parts:
Hi,

I am new to Lavaan and have a syntax question. Recently I wanted to do a multigroup analysis with 3 groups and have a question about using equality constraints in my model. From a guide I know that when I have two groups and I specify
y ~ c("b1", "b1") * x

z ~ y

and of course the group = argument in the sem() function

then I get the same path coefficient for x for both groups. Similarily I guess that with 3 groups I would write "b1" three times.

My question however is this: If I want to impose an equality constraint for only two out of the three groups, such as group a and group c, how would I specify that in my constraint?

For reference, I used both the lavaan project page and this: https://jslefche.github.io/sem_book/multigroup-analysis.html

Any help is much appreciated
